question: How is the fault of defiling attained knowledge removed according to the established teaching?
premises: Turning away at death is described as defilement of attained knowledge.
The established teaching holds that initiation into the respective lords removes that fault.
inference: The tradition acknowledges the seriousness of defiling knowledge but provides a remedial sequence through initiation.
uncertainties: tattatpureśa is compressed; it likely refers to the lords of the respective realms or abodes.
plain_english: This is described as a defilement of their knowledge and may indeed count as sin. The established view is that it is removed through the proper sequence of initiation into the lords of those respective realms.
